critique_history.assessment:
- The curved hooks visibly project above the panel instead of hanging from its bottom edge; relocate and reshape them below the lower frame rail.
- Spatula rings appear disconnected from the hooks; interlock each ring with a hook tip and connect it directly to its handle.
- Several spatula heads are undersized and nearly identical; enlarge them and preserve clearly distinct slotted, solid, fish-turner, and silicone silhouettes.
The framed rectangular backplate, five attached curved hooks, and varied suspended spatulas are clearly modeled and well proportioned.
